# Fernwell Media Group

> Fernwell Media Group (FMG) is an Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) research and education project founded by Kenneth Raymond. It studies how AI engines including ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews read, cite, and name their sources, and publishes the method in the open.

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is the practice of making a business understandable, citable, and nameable by the AI engines answering its customers' questions. Where SEO competes for rankings, AEO competes for inclusion in the answer. This site is built on that method: every page carries a connected schema.org JSON-LD graph (Organization, Person, WebSite, WebPage, FAQPage, Blog, Article), answer-first copy, and content structured for machine citation.

## Resources

- [Free AI readability and citability scanner](https://fernwellgroup.com/#scan): A single-page scan, read the way an AI crawler reads it: an eligibility check for each engine from its own published rules, plus Legibility and Citability scores. No account. No email.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://fernwellgroup.com/): What AEO is, how it works in practice, FAQ, and a free single-page legibility and citability scanner.
- [Fernwell Answers](https://fernwellgroup.com/answers/): Direct answers to questions about AI search and being visible where buying decisions now start.
- [Sitemap](https://fernwellgroup.com/sitemap/): Every page on the site in one place, plus the machine-readable feeds (XML sitemap, llms.txt, RSS).
